A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] '''commander''' [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] the forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Battle over Kothlis]]. When he was informed that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] forces nearly equaled those of the Confederacy, he chose to retreat.
